title: Spirit of the Plants
about: “The spirit of the plants has come to me, in the form of a beautiful dancing green woman.” A medicine-circle song whose verses walk the elements — wind, earth and sea, each a dancing woman of her own color — printed in eleven books of the collection. The melody here follows the singing on Release — Spirit of the Plants, which lands exactly in the books' D-minor chording.
